name: testsprite
description: Unofficial. Steering layer for the TestSprite CLI: set up a repo, audit coverage, verify changes before 'done', and gate CI. Honest about what TestSprite can and cannot test (web, HTTP APIs, hosted MCP; not stdio MCP servers or CLI binaries).

guard.title: Confirm spend and destructive commands
guard.description: Ask before TestSprite commands that fan out billable runs, delete data, overwrite files, or put a secret on the command line.

stop_gate.title: Ask for a verdict before 'done'
stop_gate.description: In repos linked to a TestSprite project, once per change set, ask for a test verdict or an explicit 'unverified because ...'. Off by default: the session directive already made 5 of 5 measured sessions verify or say why not, so the gate is an opt-in backstop.

confirm_runs_over.title: Confirm runs over
confirm_runs_over.description: Ask before one command that can start more than this many billable runs.
